name: labs/angli339__tecan-fluent-api
title: Tecan Fluent liquid handler through FluentControl (tecan_fluent.tecan_ctrl.Tecan)
intro: Tecan Fluent liquid handler through FluentControl (tecan_fluent.tecan_ctrl.Tecan), adapted from angli339/tecan-fluent-api. It reads `fluent_status` and `channel_open`; runs `liha_aspirate`, `liha_dispense`, `liha_mix`, `mca_aspirate` and 2 more. `liha_aspirate`: aspirate a volume through one LiHa tip from a 96-well labware well. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
